summary: Helix Energy Solutions Group Inc. (Parent) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement with Hornbeck Offshore Services Inc. (Company). Under the terms, Helix will acquire Hornbeck in a stock-for-stock merger: each share of Hornbeck common stock will convert into 10.27167 shares of Helix common stock (post-conversion to Delaware corporation). Post-close, Helix shareholders will own ~45% and Hornbeck shareholders ~55% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis. The combined company will be renamed Hornbeck Offshore Services Inc. and remain listed on NYSE. The Helix board approved the agreement and transactions. No break fee or regulatory clock is stated. The risk-arb angle is the exchange ratio and ownership split; watch for shareholder votes and regulatory clearance.
